stem: What happens next in this passage after “Because the driver knew the list, he noticed Ray was still on board and called his parents.”?
options: Andy knew she was being kind without making him feel embarrassed.
Ray was embarrassed, but his parents were grateful.
Some parents write to their children.
Some parents worried the children would get dirty or distracted.
